candidates.source_title: Why Soldiers Still Carry the P38 😳
candidates.source_description:
Why do soldiers and veterans still carry this tiny P38 can opener decades after it was introduced?
.
The P38 became a military legend because of its compact design and versatility. Originally designed to open ration cans, it could also be used for small everyday tasks in the field.
.
This Short explores the history, uses, and enduring popularity of the iconic P38 military can opener.
